fact: The Minister of Communications and Innovation and the Botswana Information Technology Society's chair co-chaired a meeting of the ICT Sector Sub High Level Consultative Committee, where private-sector bodies presented and the committee was briefed on the Digital Services Act, the Cybersecurity Act and the AI Policy, and agreed to reconvene in three months.
title: Today I had the privilege of Co-Chairing the ICT Sector Sub High Level Consultative Committee
